implemented_requirements.requirement: Define game constants (grid size, words per group, max mistakes, difficulty tiers)
implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.py defines GRID_SIZE, WORDS_PER_GROUP, MAX_MISTAKES, DIFFICULTY_ORDER, DIFFICULTY_COLORS, DIFFICULTY_LABELS.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Represent a puzzle with four categories of four words each
implemented_requirements.evidence: puzzle_generator.py contains a Puzzle class stub with docstring describing four categories of four words.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Select a daily puzzle deterministically from a puzzle bank
implemented_requirements.evidence: puzzle_generator.py mentions daily‑puzzle selection in the module docstring, but the actual code implementing date‑based selection is not present in the excerpt.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Shuffle the word grid each game
implemented_requirements.evidence: No function or method related to shuffling appears in the provided files.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display a 4x4 grid of words and allow the player to select four at a time
implemented_requirements.evidence: No UI code (e.g., Tkinter, PyGame, web framework) is present; only constants are defined.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate guesses, give immediate feedback, track mistakes (max 4)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No game‑logic code handling selections, validation, feedback, or mistake counting is visible.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Reveal correct groups with category name and color‑coded difficulty
implemented_requirements.evidence: No implementation for revealing groups or mapping categories to difficulty colors is shown.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Enforce a single unique solution despite ambiguous word fits
implemented_requirements.evidence: Only a placeholder description exists; no algorithmic enforcement is evident.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a new puzzle each day
implemented_requirements.evidence: Daily‑puzzle generation logic is not present.

critical_issues: Missing UI layer to render the 4x4 word grid and capture player input.
No game loop or event handling for selecting words, checking groups, or updating the display.
Daily puzzle selection code is absent; only a comment hints at intended behavior.
No feedback mechanism (correct/incorrect guess, mistake counter) is present.
The Puzzle class is incomplete (constructor body omitted), so puzzle data cannot be instantiated.
judge.summary: The repository contains only configuration constants and a skeletal Puzzle class with no functional code. Core gameplay features—grid display, word selection, validation, feedback, mistake tracking, shuffle, and deterministic daily puzzle generation—are missing. Consequently, the submission does not meet the benchmark requirements and is unlikely to be executable in its current state.
